Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Wood Mirror, 30"H, Walnut And Black
Colors: Walnut and Black
Materials: walnut
Bring simple sophistication to your entrance hallway with this mirrored organizer. The walnut wood with mirror features hooks ideal for hats and purses. It's versatile for various style rooms and busy families, making grab-and-go easy and stylish. 21" W x 30" H Mirrored glass, fiberboard, black metal hooks Ready to hang, all hardware included
